specification.design: Retrospective analysis of prospectively journaled public data; not prospective strategy validation
specification.liquidation_groups: BTC fills grouped by first-receipt UTC minute and liquidated side; decide at the next minute boundary
specification.spot_confirmation: 5m and 15m as-of spot imbalance both oppose the forced trade; unknown coverage abstains
specification.inventory_sampling: Earliest usable recorded BTC base-inventory change in each UTC quarter hour; unchanged frozen cohort
specification.price_reference: First recorded OKX spot ticker with event and receipt at/after decision, within 120 seconds; no historical price fetch
specification.statistics: Report all available movements and greedy non-overlapping interval counts; no significance or promotion claim
